events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is guessing that Rachel Green and Phoebe Buffay have seen the unspecified thing Joey Tribbiani is referring to.
Joey Tribbiani says Rachel Green and Phoebe Buffay have seen the unspecified thing Joey Tribbiani is referring to.
Rachel Green says Joey Tribbiani has seen an unspecified thing and asks what it is.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green and Phoebe Buffay were laughing.
Phoebe Buffay says Joey Tribbiani knows that laughter can be infectious.
Phoebe Buffay says that laughter is infectious.
